home.layout: Top header strip with site name and search bar, city selector beneath, then a two-column unordered list of all category links filling the viewport with no scroll required.

housing.layout: Single-column plain-text list of apartment listings; each row is date + price + bedrooms + neighborhood as a blue hyperlink, with sub-area filter sidebar on the left and pagination at the bottom.

jobs.layout: Sub-category index at top (accounting, admin, tech, etc.) followed by a date-sorted plain-text list of job posts with area tag in parentheses.

forsale.layout: Dense plain-text list of items grouped under sub-category headings, each line showing date, title as hyperlink, price, and neighborhood.

community.layout: Forum-style board index listing community sub-forums with post counts, followed by threaded discussion entries with date stamps and flag links.
